title: Director - Data & AI Consulting
description:
Principal / Director – Data & AI Consulting
Location: London (Hybrid)
Salary: £130,000 - £160,000 + Bonus + Benefits
Type: Permanent

We're working with a leading global technology consultancy looking to appoint a Principal / Director to help drive the growth of its Data & AI consulting practice across the UK and Western Europe.

This is a senior, client-facing position combining Data & AI strategy, commercial leadership and technical solution shaping, with a particular focus on Generative AI, Agentic AI and enterprise data transformation.


Requirements

  • Strong background in Data & AI consulting, ideally at Principal, Director or equivalent level.
  • Proven commercial experience, including business development, pre-sales, winning engagements and account growth.
  • Strong technical foundations across Data Science, Machine Learning and AI.
  • Good understanding of modern AI technologies, including LLMs, GenAI, Agentic AI and MLOps/LLMOps.
  • Experience advising senior stakeholders and shaping complex enterprise transformation programmes.
  • Ability to bridge commercial discussions and technical delivery, working confidently with both business leaders and engineering teams.


No sponsorship available.
